source.source_title: iPod touch (4th generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page captured as original HTML on 2026-11-11; 16 table sections extracted. The first record section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page.
notes: Technical specifications in the following sections are transcribed from the model-specific Apple technical-specification page; each section carries its own source URL and archive path.

The first section preserves model number/introduction-date evidence from Apple's separate identification page: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823, archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. These are identification-page records, not full historical technical-specification sheets; no absent specs inferred.

sections.heading: iPod touch (4th generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Multi-Touch display
Capacity: 8, 16, 32 and 64 GB
Model numbers and dates introduced: A1367: October 2012 A1367: October 2011 A1367: September 2010
Model numbers and dates introduced:
A1367: October 2012
A1367: October 2011
A1367: September 2010
iPod touch (4th generation) has an iSight camera and FaceTime HD camera.
iPod touch (4th generation) is available in white and black.

sections.heading: Size and Weight 2
sections.source_text: Height: 4.4 inches (111.0 mm) Width: 2.32 inches (58.9 mm) Depth: 0.28 inch (7.2 mm) Weight: 3.56 ounces (101 grams)

sections.heading: Wireless 3
sections.source_text: 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi (802.11n 2.4GHz only) Bluetooth 2.1 + EDR Maps-location based service 4 Nike+ support built in 5

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text: 3.5-inch (diagonal) widescreen Multi-Touch display 960-by-640-pixel resolution at 326 pixels per inch

sections.heading: Camera, Photos, and Video
sections.source_text: Video recording, HD (720p) up to 30 frames per second with audio; still photos (960 by 720) with back camera VGA-quality photos and video up to 30 frames per second with front camera Tap to control exposure for video or stills Photo and video geotagging over Wi-Fi

sections.heading: Input and Output
sections.source_text: 30-pin dock connector 3.5-mm stereo headphone minijack Built-in speaker Microphone

sections.heading: Power and Battery 6
sections.source_text: Built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery Music playback time: Up to 40 hours when fully charged Video playback time: Up to 7 hours when fully charged Charging times: Fast charge in about 2 hours (80% capacity), full charge in about 4 hours

sections.heading: Audio
sections.source_text: Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Audio formats supported: AAC (8 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), HE-AAC, MP3 (8 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, 4, Audible Enhanced Audio, AAX, and AAX+), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV User-configurable maximum volume limit

sections.heading: TV and Video
sections.source_text: H.264 video up to 720p, 30 frames per second, Main Profile level 3.1 with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats MPEG-4 video up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Simple Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps per channel, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats Motion JPEG (M-JPEG) up to 35 Mbps, 1280 by 720 pixels, 30 frames per second, audio in ulaw, PCM stereo audio in .avi file format Support for 1024 by 768 pixels with Apple VGA Adapter; 576p and 480p with Apple Component AV Cable; 576i and 480i with Apple Composite AV Cable (cables sold separately)

sections.heading: Headphones
sections.source_text: Earphones Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Impedance: 32 ohms

sections.heading: Sensors
sections.source_text: Three-axis gyro Accelerometer Ambient light sensor

sections.heading: System Requirements
sections.source_text: Apple ID (required for some features) Internet access 3 Syncing with iTunes on a Mac or PC requires: Mac: OS X v10.5.8 or later PC: Windows 7; Windows Vista; or Windows XP Home or Professional with Service Pack 3 or later iTunes 10.5 or later (free download from www.itunes.com/uk/download ) 7

sections.heading: Environmental Requirements
sections.source_text: Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C) Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C) Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)
